title: mutate_guard --changed fails when the change has mutants and none of them ran
why: Owner, in this triage session's chat, 16:47 CST Nov 10: "Do this task here: 'Fail mutate_guard --changed when no mutant runs'".
note: Today hooks/mutate_guard.py changed_main exits 0 whatever the share, so a run where every mutant is not_run (no suite reaches the file, or the budget ran out) reads 0/0 and passes. Fix: exit 1 with a 'no mutant ran' line when made > 0 and ran == 0. A change with no mutable line (made == 0, such as docs only) still exits 0, so docs-only PRs get no false alarm. actions/mutation-report/action.yml shows that line in the job summary instead of 'did not run'. Test-author first (hooks/test_mutate_ci.py), then builder.
